title: Remove Home settings raw action flat exports
summary: Removed settingsRawActionPlanRows and settingsRawActionPlanStatus as transitional flat Settings aliases and moved Home's Raw Action Plan digest to window.mediaPipelineSettingsView. WebView flat exports are now 383 across 48 files.
reason: Continue the active WebView flat export cleanup workstream by moving the only remaining Home consumer for the Settings Raw Action Plan row/status helpers to namespace-first access.
behavior_before: Home read settingsRawActionPlanRows and settingsRawActionPlanStatus as bare global functions, and settingsView.js published those helpers as flat window aliases in addition to the mediaPipelineSettingsView namespace.
behavior_after: Home reads the same helpers from window.mediaPipelineSettingsView, and settingsView.js keeps them namespace-only. renderSettingsRawActionPlan remains a flat alias for the existing browser smoke/test hook. No backend routes, settings persistence, filesystem mutation, publish/drain, or media policy behavior changed.
manual_validation: Baseline targeted tests failed before the source edit because app/home.js still used bare settingsRawActionPlanRows/settingsRawActionPlanStatus and settingsView.js still assigned the two flat aliases.

rollback_plan: Revert this change packet to restore settingsRawActionPlanRows/settingsRawActionPlanStatus flat aliases and Home bare-global lookups, regenerate WebView contract/map/slice artifacts and summaries, and restore WebView flat-export counts in Docs/CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.md and Docs/inventories/WEBVIEW_GLOBAL_EXPORT_INVENTORY.md.

Python impact: Python changes are test-only browser/static expectations; no runtime Python API, backend route, settings persistence, media policy, filesystem mutation, source media, pending publish, or repair/reconcile behavior changed.
